currentTwLabel: 營運產生之現金流入（流出）

note.zh-TW: 模板只寫「小計」，網站照教材顯示；IAS 7 釋例的名稱「營運產生之現金」列為別名，直接法版面的同一列共用這張名詞卡。
note.en: The template only says subtotal and the site follows it; the IAS 7 illustrative name, cash generated from operations, is kept as an alias, and the direct-method line shares this card.

definition.zh-TW: 稅前淨利經過非現金項目與營運資金變動調整後的小計，是在扣掉利息與所得稅付現之前，本業實際產生的現金。間接法與直接法在這一列必須相等。
definition.en: The subtotal after adjusting profit before tax for non-cash items and working capital changes: the cash the business generated before interest and tax payments. The indirect and direct methods must agree on this line.
